name: Peak Limiter
purpose: Transparent lookahead peak limiter with true-peak detection; the final safety stage that holds the output under the ceiling.

latency.note: Lookahead latency reported to the host through the 'latency' output port.

expose.ai_hint: Drives the signal into the limiter. Keep at 0-3 dB unless loudness is requested; upstream allows +30 dB.
Output ceiling. Plugsalot never allows above -1 dB.
Release time in seconds; 0.01 s default, longer for smoother limiting.
Keep on so inter-sample peaks are caught.

hidden_reason: The enable port is driven by Plugsalot's own bypass.
notes: The validator places this module last in any chain and allows only one.
Release has no unit in the Turtle file; x42 documents it in seconds.
CPU: 0.06% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
Not offered while tracking: limiting individual tracks during recording hides clipping the performer should hear. Its lookahead is about 1.3 ms.
